feeds.title: The Educational Journey Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Ellie Smith and I am a retired special education teacher. I became involved with using authentic projects to teach during my tenure in Maryland. I am passionate about using authentic projects (often referred to as project-based learning). The plan for this blog is to feature ideas for teaching and parenting.

feeds.title: PBLWorks Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Project-Based Learning for all. Topics covered are how-to tips & tools, success stories, projects in action, PBL & Equity, teaching practices, design elements, and everything PBL. PBLWorks offers a variety of online PBL workshops, courses, and services for educators.

feeds.title: Be Unbound Blog
feeds.description: Project Based Education blog is where academics meets hands-on application. At Unbound, we develop exceptional Christian leaders by providing the tools, community, and experiences that enable an extraordinary life of purpose.

feeds.title: Performing in Education » Project-based Learning
feeds.description: Check out these posts for more information on successfully implementing PBL in your classroom. My name is April Smith and my mission is to help you engage your students in meaningful learning without extra planning. I work hard to provide teachers and support staff with explicit, easy-to-implement project ideas.

feeds.title: emergent math
feeds.description: I used to teach math at a high school. Then I taught math at a high school using Project-Based Learning (PBL). This blog is dedicated to brainstorming interesting and dynamic math problems and projects. Explore my featured blog posts, Problem Based curriculum maps, or other professional development resources.

feeds.title: TeachThought » Project-Based Learning Blog
feeds.description: TeachThought is an idea and brand dedicated to innovation in K-12 education. This is pursued by growing teaching through thought leadership, professional development, resource curation, curriculum development, podcast publishing, and collaboration with organizations around the world.

feeds.title: Bianca Hewes
feeds.description: Head Teacher of Teaching & Learning, education author and blogger. This is one of those project-based learning blogs built on hard-earned experience and practical wisdom.

feeds.title: Getting Smart » Project-Based Learning
feeds.description: Getting Smart, a learning design firm, provides strategic design, growth, learner experience, and knowledge design services that turn ideas into impact. Our mission is to accelerate and amplify innovations in teaching and learning.

feeds.title: Project Pals
feeds.description: Articles from Project Pals thought leaders on project-based learning and related subjects. Key topics covered are computational thinking, critical thinking, inquiry-based learning, new projects, and company updates. Project Pals is a web-based project creation environment, where students can collaborate on projects in real-time.
